Package ro.sync.ecss.extensions.api.webapp.plugin

Class FilterURLConnection

java.lang.Object
java.net.URLConnection
ro.sync.ecss.extensions.api.webapp.plugin.FilterURLConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileBrowsingConnection
@API(src=PUBLIC, type=EXTENDABLE) public class FilterURLConnection extends URLConnection implements FileBrowsingConnection
URLConnection that delegates all methods to the connection given as a parameter.
